# Requirements: deep-extend

## REQ-1

Evidence:
- class `deep-extend:default:class:arrays|returned` (156 recorded inputs): deep-extend:default:0223b466d5ef, deep-extend:default:0451d947a52f, deep-extend:default:047c78200a48

## REQ-2

## REQ-6

When arguments are null or primitive values, deep-extend may return false to indicate no merge was performed.

Evidence:

## REQ-7

Evidence:

## REQ-8

When a single argument is provided, deep-extend returns that argument unchanged.

Evidence:
- class `deep-extend:default:class:single|returned` (16 recorded inputs): deep-extend:default:b713f6d2a989

## REQ-9

# Design: deep-extend

This design follows the recorded behavior of `deep-extend`. 9 / 9 requirements cite evidence.

## Behaviors to implement

### REQ-1

When all arguments are arrays, deep-extend returns a merged array.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:arrays|returned`

### REQ-2

When all arguments are arrays, deep-extend may throw a TypeError for invalid array inputs.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:arrays|threw:TypeError`

### REQ-3

When all arguments are arrays, deep-extend may throw a non‑TypeError exception for unexpected errors.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:arrays|threw:other`

### REQ-4

When arguments contain nested objects, deep-extend returns a merged object preserving the nested structure.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:nested|returned`

### REQ-5

When arguments are null or primitive values, deep-extend returns the first non‑object argument unchanged.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:null-or-primitive|returned`

### REQ-6

When arguments are null or primitive values, deep-extend may return false to indicate no merge was performed.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:null-or-primitive|returned-false`

### REQ-7

When arguments are null or primitive values, deep-extend may throw a TypeError for invalid primitive inputs.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:null-or-primitive|threw:TypeError`

### REQ-8

When a single argument is provided, deep-extend returns that argument unchanged.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:single|returned`

### REQ-9

When two plain (non‑nested, non‑array) objects are provided, deep-extend returns a merged object containing properties from both.

Behavior classes: `deep-extend:default:class:two-plain|returned`

## Approach

Implement each behavior as a small function. Compare the rebuild with the recorded Evidence IDs listed in requirements.md.
